papers.title: Read It Back: Pretrained MLLMs Are Zero-Shot Reward Models for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Runhui Huang, Qihui Zhang, Zhe Liu, Yu Gao, Jie Wu, Hengshuang Zhao
papers.affiliations: The University of Hong Kong, ByteDance Seed, Peking University
papers.intro: 本文提出SpectraReward，一种无需训练的奖励函数，通过计算生成图像条件下的平均提示似然来利用预训练MLLM的图像-文本对齐能力，并进一步提出Self-SpectraReward实现在统一多模态模型中的闭环自改进。

papers.title: Latent-Identity Tuning in Text-to-Image Personalization Models
papers.authors: Daniel Garibi, Ronen Kamenetsky, Hadar Averbuch-Elor, Daniel Cohen-Or, Or Patashnik
papers.affiliations: 1Tel Aviv University, 2Cornell University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种无需额外训练的方法，通过分析预训练冻结编码器的隐空间，发现并利用语义方向对身份令牌进行细粒度、局部化的编辑，实现身份表示的直接调优。

papers.title: Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering
papers.authors: Shijie Wang, Honglu Zhou, Ziyang Wang, Ran Xu, Caiming Xiong, Silvio Savarese, Chen Sun, Juan Carlos Niebles
papers.affiliations: Salesforce AI Research, Palo Alto, CA, USA; Brown University, Providence, RI, USA
papers.intro: 本文提出证据支持的视频问答（E-VQA）任务，要求模型同时输出语义答案、相关时间片段和密集跟踪的分割掩码，并构建了人工验证的基准ST-Evidence和160k规模指令微调数据集ST-Evidence-Instruct，通过微调显著提升联合推理和像素级证据定位性能。

papers.title: HASTE: A Platform for Rapid Post-Disaster Building Damage Assessment
papers.authors: Caleb Robinson, Anthony Ortiz, Simone Fobi Nsutezo, Cameron Birge, Meygha Machado, Marcelo Duarte, Joaquin Rivero Rodriguez, Anthony Cintron Roman, Kevin White, Inbal Becker-Reshef, Juan M. Lavista Ferres
papers.affiliations: Microsoft AI for Good Research Lab
papers.intro: HASTE是一个无代码网页平台，通过仅需少量标注的两种方法（单场景语义分割或足迹嵌入+浏览器内分类器），让非机器学习专家在数小时内从灾后卫星影像生成每栋建筑的损伤图，已支持2023年以来30多次真实灾害响应。

papers.title: Cycle-World: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Long-term Video World Models via Reverse-Prediction Cycle Consistency
papers.authors: Zihan Su, Teng Hu, Jiangning Zhang, Ruiyan Wang, Ran Yi, Lizhuang Ma, Dacheng Tao
papers.affiliations: Zihan Su, Teng Hu, Ruiyan Wang, Ran Yi, Lizhuang Ma - 上海交通大学；Jiangning Zhang - 浙江大学；Dacheng Tao - 南洋理工大学
papers.intro: Cycle-World通过强制时间可逆性（循环一致性）在训练和推理阶段约束前向生成漂移，显著抑制了长视频自回归生成中的误差累积和结构性幻觉。

papers.title: MM-ToolSandBox: A Unified Framework for Evaluating Visual Tool-Calling Agents
papers.authors: Kaixin Ma, Di Feng, Alexander Metz, Jiarui Lu, Eshan Verma, Afshin Dehghan
papers.affiliations: Apple
papers.intro: 提出MM-ToolSandBox，一个统一的基准和评估框架，用于多轮、多图像、大工具空间（500+工具）下的视觉工具调用代理评估，通过258个人工验证场景和50个UI变体测试12个SOTA模型，发现即使最强模型成功率低于50%，且视觉精度而非规划能力是主要瓶颈。

papers.title: StoryTeller: Training-Free Narrative Grounding for Long-Form Audio Description
papers.authors: Seung Hyun Hahm, Minh T. Dinh, SouYoung Jin
papers.affiliations: Dartmouth College, USA
papers.intro: StoryTeller提出一种无需训练的长格式音频描述框架，通过显式的叙事记忆机制（身份图 + 显著性权重记忆）跨场景传播故事相关信息，显著提升叙述连贯性和事实依据，且仅需原始视频和电影标题。

papers.title: Higher-Order Cell Tracking Transformer
papers.authors: Jordão Bragantini, Ilan Theodoro, Loïc A. Royer
papers.affiliations: Biohub
papers.intro: 本文提出一种以边为中心的Transformer架构（HOCT），通过几何驱动的边自注意力机制绕过无信息候选图拓扑，并利用线到线距离编码解决细胞分裂导致的节点嵌入纠缠问题，在不依赖深度预训练图像编码器的情况下在细胞跟踪挑战中取得最佳结果。

papers.title: NeuralActuator: Neural Actuation Modeling for Robot Dynamics and External Force Perception
papers.authors: Zhiyang Dou, John U. Onyemelukwe, Hangxing Zhang, Heng Zhang, Minghao Guo, Yunsheng Tian, Michal Piotr Lipiec, Joshua Jacob, Chao Liu, Peter Yichen Chen, Yuri Ivanov, Wojciech Matusik
papers.affiliations: MIT, Amazon Robotics
papers.intro: 本文提出NeuralActuator，一种数据驱动的神经执行器模型，联合预测广义力替代量、外力（含接触概率门控）和电机状态分数，并通过可微仿真从位姿轨迹进行训练，显著提升了低成本机器人平台的动力学建模精度和无传感器外力感知能力。

papers.title: GFR-SAM: Training-Free Referring Camouflaged Object Segmentation via Cross-Image Prompting
papers.authors: Yilong Yang, Jianxin Tian, Shengchuan Zhang, Liujuan Cao
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, visual grounding, Segment Anything
papers.affiliations: Key Laboratory of Multimedia Trusted Perception and Efficient Computing, Ministry of Education of China, Xiamen University
papers.intro: 提出GFR-SAM，一个三阶段训练-free框架，通过“生成-过滤-精炼”流程，利用SAM3的跨图像上下文提示（In-Context Exemplar）取代脆弱点匹配，实现稳健的伪装目标分割。

papers.title: Compositional Context Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Model for Complex Assembly Action Understanding from Videos
papers.authors: Hao Zheng, Jinyi Huang, Tiantian Zheng, Xun Xu, Tuka Alhanai
papers.affiliations: New York University Abu Dhabi (Department of Computer Engineering; Center for Quantum and Topological Systems; Center for AI and Robotics) & The University of Auckland (Department of Mechanical and Mechatronics Engineering)
papers.intro: 本文提出组合上下文微调（CCFT）与分层交替训练（LP-AT）方法，将装配动作分解为动词、对象、工具等语义元素，通过模板化VQA对视觉语言模型进行参数高效微调，实现近确定性、可解释的装配动作理解，并构建了两个组合式VQA装配视频数据集。

papers.title: PanoWorld: Real-World Panoramic Generation
papers.authors: Haoyuan Li, Dizhe Zhang, Yuemei Zhou, Xiangkai Zhang, Haoran Feng, Xiaofan Lin, Wenjie Jiang, Bo Du, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Lu Qi
papers.affiliations: Insta360 Research, Institute of Automation Chinese Academy of Sciences, Tsinghua University, Wuhan University, UC Merced
papers.intro: 提出PanoWorld，一个基于扩散的全景世界模型，通过利用全景表示的旋转等变性解耦旋转和平移，结合密集全景射线条件（DPRC）和几何感知记忆增强（GMA），实现可控、物理一致的全景视频生成。

papers.title: OpenLongTail: Generative Scaling of Long-Tail Driving Data
papers.authors: Lulin Liu, Nuo Chen, Yan Wang, Bangya Liu, Wenyan Cong, Hezhen Hu, Boris Ivanovic, Hao Wang, Ziyao Zeng, Xinyu Gong, Yang Zhou, Zixiang Xiong, Dilin Wang, Zhangyang Wang, Weisong Shi, Ruohan Zhang, Marco Pavone, Zhiwen Fan
papers.affiliations: Texas A&M University, NVIDIA, UW–Madison, UT Austin, Yale University, Adobe, Meta, University of Delaware, Stanford University
papers.intro: OpenLongTail 是一个开源的生成式数据引擎，通过融合 Plücker 光线几何、时域深度扭曲和跨视角记忆库，将异构长尾单目视频转换为时空连续的多视角资产，显著提升闭环驾驶策略在长尾事件下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Evolution of Accuracy and Visual-Cognitive Errors in a Decade of Vision-Language AI Models
papers.authors: Shravan Murlidaran, Miguel P. Eckstein
papers.affiliations: University of California, Santa Barbara (Psychological & Brain Sciences, Department of Computer Science, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering)
papers.intro: 本文通过构建复杂社会行为（CSB）数据集，分析了2017-2025年间九种视觉语言模型（四种预MLLM和五种MLLM）的场景描述准确性及五种视觉-认知错误类型的演变，发现MLLM已基本消除简单与复杂场景之间的准确率差距，且几乎所有错误类型均大幅减少，但仍存在空间依赖错误。

papers.title: Revisiting Euler-Angle Regression with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.authors: Yangting Sun, Zijun Cui, Yufei Zhang
papers.affiliations: Yangting Sun - Independent Researcher, Zijun Cui - Michigan State University, Yufei Zhang - Independent Researcher
papers.intro: 本文引入Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）作为回归骨干，结合实际应用中的欧拉角范围约束，提出一个利用可学习边缘函数和边界结构来稳定欧拉角回归的新框架，在多个旋转回归任务上取得了一致的改进。

papers.title: 4DR360: State Reasoning for Joint 3D Detection and Occupancy Prediction in 4D Radar-Camera Full-Scene Perception
papers.authors: Xiaokai Bai, Lianqing Zheng, Runwei Guan, Songkai Wang, Siyuan Cao, Hui-liang Shen
papers.affiliations: Xiaokai Bai, Songkai Wang, Siyuan Cao, Hui-liang Shen - College of Information Science and Electronic Engineering, Zhejiang University; Lianqing Zheng - School of Automotive Studies, Tongji University; Runwei Guan - Thrust of Artificial Intelligence, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出4DR360，一个4D雷达-相机360°全场景感知框架，通过将语义占用建模为持久场景状态并利用状态引导的BEV增强（SBE）和多普勒引导的时间融合（DTF）进行跨模态状态推理，联合实现3D检测与语义占用预测，同时扩展了ManTruckScenes的占用标注并建立统一评估协议。

papers.title: Task-Specific Multimodal Question Answering Agents via Confidence Calibration and Incremental Reasoning for QANTA 2026
papers.authors: Nirjhar Das, Md. Al-Mamun Provath
papers.affiliations: Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出针对QANTA 2026挑战的双智能体架构，通过任务特定的推理策略、置信度校准和数字推理防火墙，在资源受限的多模态问答中实现了最高整体得分。

papers.title: Promptable Concept Segmentation from Above: Evaluating SAM 3's Zero-Shot and One-Shot Capabilities in Remote Sensing
papers.authors: Mohammad Dabaja, Turgay Celik
papers.tags: image classification, object detection, instance segmentation, semantic segmentation
papers.affiliations: Department of ICT, University of Agder, Grimstad, Norway
papers.intro: 本文通过结构适应（将SAM 3存在头改造为零样本分类器）、五种提示配置的消融实验以及训练自由的代理评估协议，系统评估了SAM 3在遥感场景分类、检测和分割中的零/单样本能力，揭示了跨模态干扰（文本提示引入地面视角偏差）和亚像素分辨率等核心局限。

papers.title: Wan-Dancer: A Hierarchical Framework for Minute-scale Coherent Music-to-Dance Generation
papers.authors: Mingyang Huang, Peng Zhang, Li Hu, Guangyuan Wang, Bang Zhang
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group
papers.intro: 提出一种分层全局-局部框架，通过全局关键帧规划与局部时域细化，首次实现基于音乐与文本条件的分钟级、720p/30fps连贯舞蹈视频生成。

papers.title: TCLA: Training-Free Class-wise Logit Adaptation for Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Tianyou Jiang, Ziyu Zhou
papers.affiliations: University of Bern, Bern, Switzerland；Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China
papers.intro: 提出TCLA，一种纯无训练的类级logit适应方法，通过从少量支持样本构建多层类原型和残差映射，无需更新模型参数即可修正零样本logits，显著提高Medical VLM在多个医学模态上的OOD性能。
